items.title: Page updated: Maine Board of Overseers of the Bar — General News
items.content_text:
This page's content changed since the last check. Visit the page directly to review the update.

What changed (text excerpt):
Added:
  + Extended Registration
  + Attorney license renewal and Guardian ad Litem license renewal may be completed in the MyBoardAccess portal from September 9 through October 30, 2026 at 5:00 pm.
  + Pursuant to M. Bar R. 4,
  + Registration documents and payments received after August 31st will be assessed a non-waivable late fee.
  + Please note that license renewal requires current contact information, including a physical residence address, accurate practice type (private, government, judicial, etc.), proxy designation for all private practitioners, and IOLTA account listing or an accurate IOLTA exemption.
  + If your status has changed since last year (no longer a law clerk, are retired seeking Inactive, new judge or seeking to become active again), please contact execassistant@mebaroverseers.org to request a status change
  + before you register in the portal.
  + Registration is completed online on the
  + MyBoardAccess
  + by clicking on the Renew Registration section of the Board's web portal.
